title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site update
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Adds RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; updates docs site with runnable examples and reference snippets. No breaking changes to public APIs.
description: Context: provide first-class RAG agent templates and concise tool-calling quickstarts for developers to bootstrap RAG/agent integrations. Motivation: many customers and internal teams repeatedly implement similar agent scaffolding; providing curated templates plus docs examples reduces time-to-value and prevents common misconfigurations. This PR: 1) Adds three opinionated RAG agent templates (faq-bot, enterprise-kb, and multi-tool assistant) under docs and examples. 2) Adds two tool-calling quickstarts that demonstrate HTTP tool integrations and structured outputs with function-style calls. 3) Updates the docs site navigation and quickstart landing page with runnable snippets and code tabs (Python/TypeScript). 4) Small helper in examples to standardize environment setup and test harness for local runs. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Docs pages and navigation updates - [x] Example test harness and CI sample - [x] Reviewer feedback addressed - [x] CI green Testing: local example runs with sample dataset, `make docs-build` succeeded in CI, integration smoke tests run against staging. Linked work: ENG-1298 for template design and DOC-402 for docs site changes. Notes: kept templates intentionally minimal; followups will add additional telemetry and eval prompts (ENG-1345). Backwards compatibility: no public API changes; configuration keys are additive. Merge: squashed and merged to main on 2026-02-12.
commits: Address review feedback: add environment doc and simplify examples
review_comments: Priya Nair: Please include a short note on recommended batching configs for the faq-bot template. Author reply: Added a comment block in template.yaml and docs page with recommended batch_size and cache TTL.
Luis Gomez: The tool-calling examples assume sync HTTP tools; can we surface an async pattern? Author reply: Added an async example in ts_quickstart.ts and updated the docs to mention both patterns.
Samuel Tan: CI flaky on docs-build in first run. Author reply: Fixed by pinning mkdocs-plugins and re-running; docs-build passed on second run and CI is green.
